parameters.domain: encoded display sRGB D65 after ISP, not log or scene-linear input
parameters.status: all authored numerical parameters are design assumptions; no physical calibration

german_cool.skin_gate: red>green>blue, red-green 0.02..0.14; reduces cold tint and restores saturation

parameters.leica: neutralise community output using Rec.709 encoded RGB weights; cannot emulate monochrome sensor detail, spectral response or dynamic range
parameters.polaroid: PX-680 is an explicit historical proxy; no Polachrome, 669 peel-apart, expired-film LUT or added white border
parameters.textures: off by default; LUT alone cannot add grain, bloom, vignetting or print texture

stocks.name: Leica Monochrome
stocks.reference: Street Monochrome Eerie community LUT, neutralised; Leica-inspired tonal interpretation, no sensor response emulation
stocks.title: LEICA

stocks.name: Lomography
stocks.reference: independent Color Negative 400-inspired interpretation; no verified same-stock LUT found; X-Pro 200 and Redscale are NOT substituted
stocks.title: LOMO

stocks.name: Polaroid
stocks.reference: community Impossible/Polaroid PX-680 LUT as an explicit 600-compatible instant-colour proxy, NOT a measured modern 600 or i-Type transform
stocks.title: POLAR

stocks.name: Fujifilm Velvia 50
stocks.reference: same-name community Fuji Velvia 50 cube; RVP50 official curves are qualitative checks, not measured GR conversion
stocks.title: VELV

stocks.name: Cyberpunk
stocks.reference: independent cyan-shadow/magenta-neon artistic LUT; no canonical film or licensed reference transform
stocks.title: CYBER

stocks.name: Cyanotype
stocks.reference: independent Prussian-blue to paper-white positive print interpretation; no scanned print calibration or negative correction LUT
stocks.title: CYANO

stocks.name: 德系冷调
stocks.reference: independent restrained cool-grey artistic look with skin gate; no unique German manufacturer standard
stocks.title: COOL

limits: Errors compare implementation to its designed display target only. Real camera/film error unknown. No claim of 100 percent replication.
